graph_change_definition: Exact difference in the six modality adjacency tensors returned by GraphLearn/DARG, compared with the corresponding historical H model.

dpsl_patient_analysis.definition: Native is the same Best checkpoint with DPSL disabled. Full is the same checkpoint with DPSL enabled.
dpsl_patient_analysis.relative_to_H4: Candidate Full and Native are paired by sample index to historical H4 Full and Native.
